notes.content: - FFB driver updated. VC++ Redist 2014+ and DInput 8 (latest Direct X required)

notes.title: v0.1.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
- FFB driver installed and deleted Logitech dependencies (TY to Dan from ATG-Simulator.com)
- Tire model updated to MF 6.2 (tires feel very different now)
- Added experimental FFB (FFBType 2 in PlayerPref.json)
- Button binding fixes (min/max work better, binding works better, invert is automatic but still available)
- Fixed reverse not working with controllers
- FFB multiplier and steering assist moved to in-game ui
- Removed controller binding from launcher

notes.title: v0.1.0 release notes
notes.content:
- Launcher UI now has the option to turn on/off controller and steer assist
- Launcher UI now has the option to install Logitech GSDK for FFB
- Escape button now closes control menu in game
- Launcher track selection bug fixed where it doesn't select any track
- Procedural touge pregens 10 pieces to start
- Invert brake pedal now works
- Added ability to undo all min/maxes with "reset all" function
- Added discord link to launcher
- Added ability to lower FFB percentage in launcher
- Bug fixed where min/maxes and inversions don't save
- Potential fix for control files not saving correctly
